Whitewashing a cellar wall is a simple way to protect your cistern from moisture and damage. It also improves the appearance of your home and makes cleaning easier. By whitewashing, you're keeping your cistern clean and dry, which is essential for proper water storage. This task is best done in the early morning when the walls are coolest. Make sure to cover all surfaces and allow the whitewash to dry completely. The process is quick and can be done with a brush or sponge. 

P.P.S. Do not forget the storage shed.
